Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLII OF 2001
ORDINANCE XLII OF 2001
REFORMATORY
SCHOOLS (BALOCHISTAN
AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Reformatory
Schools Act, 1897
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
30th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79/Law/IV,
dated 30‑10‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Reformatory Schools (Balochistan Amendment)
Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force on
the 14th day of August, 2001.

Amendment of section 8 of Act VIII of 1897

ORDINANCE XLII OF 2001
ORDINANCE XLII OF 2001
REFORMATORY
SCHOOLS (BALOCHISTAN
AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Reformatory
Schools Act, 1897
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
30th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79/Law/IV,
dated 30‑10‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 8 of Act VIII of 1897.‑‑‑In
the Balochistan Reformatory Schools Act, 1897, hereinafter referred to as the
said Act in subsection (2) of section 8, for the words "District
Magistrate" the word "Magistrate" shall be substituted.
